criteria.label: Hiring activity
criteria.why: An agency that is actively hiring is feeling the recruiting and onboarding workload right now. This is the "why now" for outreach.

criteria.label: Back-office hiring
criteria.why: Hiring schedulers, coordinators or compliance staff means the back office is stretched, which is the workload an operations product takes on.

criteria.label: Web presence
criteria.why: A live website means a real, operating business a rep can research and reach. Many registry entries are shell or dormant entities with no presence at all.

criteria.label: Multi-site
criteria.why: Multi-site operators have more staff to recruit and schedule, and one deal covers several locations.

criteria.label: Agency type
criteria.why: Confirms the account is the kind of agency the product is built for, not an adjacent business the search happened to return.

criteria.label: Maturity
criteria.why: Agencies a few years in are established enough to have budget and still adding staff. Brand-new entities are often not operating yet.

criteria.label: Tech posture
criteria.why: An agency already paying for hiring software buys tools to solve operational problems, so a software conversation is not a first.
